sermon.title: Not a Spirit of Fear 07/07/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that God has not given us a spirit of fear but of power, love and a sound mind. Drawing on his own years repairing televisions, he compares God’s power with electricity: present since creation but useless until applied, and dangerous outside its rules. Knowledge without power is self-destruction; application brings abundant life.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

Everybody’s trying to tell me what to do I need you to come and tell me what did it is that fair enough is that scripture let’s go back here Ezekiel 36:26 a new heart I will give you that heart is the mind and the emotions of man the soul a new heart I will give you that old heart of stone that old hard in sensitivity that old mind that wasn’t disciplined and all that I’m gonna give you a new discipline mind. And I’m gonna give you a new spirit. That spirit of power and I will put within you and cause you look at this I will cause you to walk in my statutes not you trying to force these things and get it done I will motivate you I will empower you to walk in my statutes and my judgments.

Amen. That’s the power of God and then you have over here on the left the Holy Ghost shall come upon you he’s talking to Mary the Holy Ghost shall come upon you the power the most high shall overshadow you see that spirit of power is everywhere in these banners. The most high shall have a shadow you Luke 1:35 and so Mary brought forth a child. Because the Holy Ghost came upon her the power of God overshadowed her and supernaturally a child was created then you go to Galatians 4:19 Paul says I travail in Christ again until Christ is formed in you I pray I travail for you till Christ is formed in you if Jesus could be formed in Mary as a natural baby and child can Jesus be formed in us spiritually.

Alleluia and in that what it’s all about and then it comes out naturally I don’t have to have ten rules of success and all that it’s just a natural flow of a power of God that I speak and behave myself 2nd Corinthians 3:18 all are changed into the same image of Jesus from glory to glory you’re not going to get mature overnight get rid of that you’re going to go from one glory to another glory one faith to another faith one truth to another truth and how do we do that by the Spirit by the spirit I have not given you a spirit of fear but a spirit of power of love and a sound mind he is going to change us into the image of Christ have Christ formed india in us so he radiates out of us by the spirit of God.

scriptures.text_nkjv: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.

And the angel answered and said to her, “The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Highest will overshadow you; therefore, also, that Holy One who is to be born will be called the Son of God.

faqs.question: Can you focus on one part?
Is there a better life now?
What should we ask God?
faqs.answer: Come and tell me what to do.
